summary: RptDestPlcSchedule is a user control in the HSPnet system for generating Destination Placement Schedule reports. It provides configurable options for report creation, supports multiple destinations, and includes UI controls for selecting terms and date ranges. The control validates user input and ensures constraints such as maximum destinations are respected, providing workflow support and error feedback.
purpose: To allow users (typically placement coordinators or administrators) to generate detailed placement schedules for selected destinations, filtered by date range and term, and optionally include additional report options such as individual PDFs and appended schedules.

fields.name: radConfirmedRequests
fields.description: Option to include only confirmed requests.

fields.name: radAcceptedConfirmed
fields.description: Option to include accepted and confirmed.

fields.name: radPendRedirAcceptedConfirmed
fields.description: Option to include pending and redirected, accepted, and confirmed.

fields.name: chkIndividualPDF
fields.description: Option to generate individual PDFs for each destination.

workflows.name: Generate Destination Placement Schedule Report
steps: User selects term from ddTerm dropdown.
User enters start and end dates in txtStartDate and txtEndDate.
User chooses request inclusion option (Confirmed, Accepted, Pending/Redirected) via radio buttons.
User selects additional report options (Individual PDF, Append Schedule).
System validates input dates and selected destinations.
System checks if the user session is monitoring another user; disables report generation if true.
System checks count of selected destinations. If zero, displays error message; if over maximum allowed, displays error message.
System creates placement schedule report job via PrintJobs.ReportPlacementScheduleCreateJob with selected parameters.

business_rules: User must select at least one destination to generate a report.
Maximum number of destinations included in a report is limited by PrintJobs.MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
Option chkIndividualPDF only visible if more than one destination is selected.
Report generation is disabled if UserSession.SwitchUserViewOnly is true.
Date fields must match expected format (validated by RegularExpressionValidator).
validations: Regular expression validation on txtStartDate and txtEndDate.
CustomValidator1 for additional business logic as needed.
calculations: If multiple destinations are selected, system concatenates IDs for reporting.
IncludeOption is calculated based on radio button selections: 0 = confirmed only, 1 = accepted, 2 = pending/redir.
conditions: Report creation only proceeds if destination count > 0 and < MAX_INCLUDE_ITEMS.
chkIndividualPDF visibility is conditional on DestinationAccessList(UserSession).Count > 1.
system_behavior: On initial load, ddTerm binds available terms.
JavaScript variables for client controls are registered.
If monitoring a user, report button is hidden.
On report generation, calls PrintJobs.ReportPlacementScheduleCreateJob with selected parameters.
exceptions: If no destinations are selected, displays error and aborts report generation.
If destination count exceeds maximum allowed, displays error and aborts.
If UserSession is in SwitchUserViewOnly mode, disables report button.
